agentAuthoringHint: Gives the assistant tools to create and revise artifacts and canvas documents by name, instead of relying on detection of fenced code blocks. Revisions still follow the review setting above.
autoCreateHint: When on, qualifying code blocks in assistant replies are converted into artifacts and the side panel slides in.
defaultPanelModeHint: Initial tab when the panel opens for previewable artifacts.
description: Tune how the assistant lifts long blocks of generated content into addressable, previewable artifacts. Changes apply to new responses.
enabledTypesHint: Toggle any type off to skip it during auto-detection.
interactiveHtmlHint: Off by default. When on, an HTML artifact gains a “run the interactive version” button that re-renders it with its scripts and form controls intact, inside a sandbox with no access to the app, your cookies, or storage. You authorise each artifact separately; the static, sanitised render stays the default.
minLinesHint: Always-create types (HTML, React, SVG, Mermaid, charts, Jupyter) ignore this — they only need 3 lines.
persistAcrossSessionsHint: When on, artifacts survive restarts via localStorage. When off, they’re cleared with the session.
reviewBeforeApplyHint: When on, the assistant's edits to an existing artifact are staged as a diff proposal you review hunk-by-hunk before they apply. When off, edits overwrite the artifact directly.
showNotificationHint: Show a brief sonner toast when a new artifact is auto-created.
title: Artifacts
